pali: කස්මා තෙසං එකො හීනො, එකො පණීතො
reason: Migasālā: those who measure ask a question, “this one has those very qualities, the other too; why (කස්මා) is one of them low and one excellent?”; the Sinhala has no “why” and makes it their statement that one is low and one excellent. Put as the question (BJT’s Sinhala: “කවර හෙයින් ඔවුනතුරෙන් එකෙක් හීන වේ ද, එකෙක් ප්‍රණීත වේදැ”යි); nothing else is changed. (Outside the step-1 list, de Zoysa’s own text; the same sentence as 44:4.)
